chunks.sanskrit: # Text  anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api | ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca
sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ | bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī
śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati | tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva
chunks.l1:
## bod-p03 (3)
Power too from power-possessor-form difference does not desire; identity of these two is eternal, as fire and burning. // AgBpd_3

chunks.sanskrit: sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ | svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam
tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā | pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam
eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ | vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ
chunks.l1:
## bod-p06 (6)
This god by this goddess always play-joy-eager; varied creation-dissolution he does simultaneously, all-pervading. // AgBpd_6

chunks.sanskrit: atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat | etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā
paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam | jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate
chunks.l1:
## bod-p08 (8)
Limited-light-ness of inert indeed is mark; from inert different is awareness since not measured. // AgBpd_8

chunks.sanskrit: evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ | svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ
teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā
chunks.l1:
## bod-p10 (10)
In them variety extreme up-down across what; worlds, their parts, pleasure-pain-mind what. // AgBpd_10
chunks.l2:
## bod-p10–p11 — variety and non-knowledge
In them variety extreme up-down across what; worlds, their parts, pleasure-pain-mind what. What of it non-knowledge — that its autonomy thus stated; it indeed saṃsāra of fools who is terrifying. Extreme variety in worlds, parts, and minds; non-knowledge of this autonomy is saṃsāra — the terrifying state of fools.

chunks.sanskrit: yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam | sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ
chunks.l1:
## bod-p11 (11)
What of it non-knowledge — that its autonomy thus stated; it indeed saṃsāra of fools who is terrifying. // AgBpd_11

chunks.sanskrit: tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā | śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam
chunks.l1:
## bod-p12 (12)
From that grace-sap or from teacher-scripture or from scripture of supreme Lord from which from which approached. // AgBpd_12
chunks.l2:
## bod-p12–p14 — attainment, liberation, and non-difference
From that grace-sap or from teacher-scripture or from scripture of supreme Lord from which from which approached. What of reality full-knowledge — that is liberation from supreme Lord. That fullness of awakened, living-liberation that is remembered. These two bondage and liberation from supreme-Lord-nature. Not they differ; no difference indeed in truth in supreme Lord. Three paths to the reality (grace, teacher-scripture, Lord's scripture); full knowledge of reality = liberation = living liberation; bondage and liberation are not ultimately different in the Lord.

chunks.sanskrit: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā
chunks.l1:
## bod-p13 (13)
What of reality full-knowledge — that is liberation from supreme Lord. That fullness of awakened, living-liberation that is remembered. // AgBpd_13

chunks.sanskrit: etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ | na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare
ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ | bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate
